record.body:
## Rationale

Standalone use needs a real authoring path without orchestra. Lint makes compound claims visible. Signed human claims cover behavior that cannot be automated.

## Counter-argument

Hand-editing JSON is enough for experts. It is also how incomplete and compound claims stay invisible, which this phase is meant to fix.

payload.alternatives: hand-edit JSON plus freeze only; interactive review TUI
payload.choice: ship aff claim add and aff freeze to write and hash manifest entries; lint compound and trust-scoped wording; allow an allowlist-signed human claim as a witness instead of red-green tests
